title: Syntax Climber
description: Remove the entire 'if use_legacy_mode:' block (logic and wrapper) cleanly.
tips:
1. Move inside the 'if' block.
2. Press 'Alt-o' repeatedly to expand selection (Line -> Block -> Function).
3. 'd' to delete.
(Note: Requires tree-sitter. Starting on the 'if' keyword selects the block faster).
